form.label: Repo Annotation — Operational Metrics
form.description: Interactive Repo Annotation lifecycle, usage accounting, and automated workflow health. Setup is reported separately from successful onboarding. Invocation usage appears only when the runtime or wrapper supplies a terminal record. Measured usage remains visible when cost is unknown; unavailable accounting is never displayed as zero.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="influx:telemetry" metric_name IN ("cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation*","cisco-aifirst-prod_repo_annotation*") | eval raw_metric_name=metric_name | eval metric_name=replace(metric_name,"^cisco-aifirst-prod_","cisco-aifirst_") | eval channel=if(service_name="repo-annotation-workflow","automated","interactive") | eval runtime=coalesce(runtime,agent_id,"unknown") | eval status=coalesce(status,outcome,"unknown") | eval stage=coalesce(stage,"unknown") | eval model=coalesce(model,"unknown"), invocation_id=coalesce(invocation_id,"unknown") | eval usage_complete=coalesce(usage_complete,"unknown"), cost_basis=coalesce(cost_basis,"unknown") | eval target_repo_url=coalesce(target_repo_url,"unknown") | eval template_profile=coalesce(manifest_template_profile,seeded_template_profile,template_profile,"unknown") | fillnull value="unknown" skill_id job_id | eval dedupe_fingerprint=coalesce(event_id,md5(_time."|".metric_name."|".target_repo_url."|".skill_id."|".status."|".runtime."|".job_id)) | sort 0 dedupe_fingerprint raw_metric_name | streamstats current=f last(raw_metric_name) as previous_prefix by dedupe_fingerprint | where isnull(previous_prefix) OR raw_metric_name=previous_prefix | eval input_tokens=tonumber(input_tokens), output_tokens=tonumber(output_tokens) | eval cache_read_tokens=tonumber(cache_read_tokens), cache_write_tokens=tonumber(cache_write_tokens) | eval total_tokens=tonumber(total_tokens), cost_usd=tonumber(cost_usd) | eval reasoning_output_tokens=tonumber(reasoning_output_tokens) | eval usage_dedupe=if(invocation_id!="unknown",invocation_id,event_id) | fields _time, metric_name, value, channel, status, runtime, target_repo_url, template_profile, profile_alignment, skill_id, stage, workflow, reason, failure_kind, stop_reason, event_id, usage_dedupe, job_id, invocation_id, model, repo_annotation_version, template_library_version, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens, total_tokens, usage_complete, cost_basis, cost_usd, strategy, duration_bucket, cost_bucket, error_code

| search channel IN ($channel_filter$) | search status IN ($status_filter$) | search runtime IN ($runtime_filter$) | search target_repo_url IN ($repo_filter$) | search template_profile IN ($profile_filter$)

| stats count as events, count(eval(metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" AND stage!="diagnostics" AND stage!="dashboard-smoke-test")) as usage_events | eval show_usage_warning=if(events>0 AND usage_events=0,"active",null())
| dedup runtime | table runtime | sort runtime
| dedup target_repo_url | table target_repo_url | sort target_repo_url
| dedup template_profile | table template_profile | sort template_profile

div.p: Lifecycle counters remain available without usage accounting. Token panels use measured runtime values; cost panels sum only authoritative reported cost.

html.div: Usage accounting has not been received for this filter window. Lifecycle metrics may still be healthy; run a host-integrated terminal usage test before reading token or cost panels.

search.query: | search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_installed" status="success" | stats sum(value) as total | fillnull value=0 total

| search channel="interactive" target_repo_url!="unknown" | search metric_name IN ("cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_onboarding_started","cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_used") | stats dc(target_repo_url) as total | fillnull value=0 total
| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_repo_onboarded" target_repo_url!="unknown" | stats dc(target_repo_url) as total | fillnull value=0 total
| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" | stats dc(usage_dedupe) as total | fillnull value=0 total
| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_interactive_repo_onboarded" target_repo_url!="unknown" | stats dc(target_repo_url) as total | fillnull value=0 total

chart.title: Onboarding completions over time by channel

search.query: | where metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_interactive_repo_onboarded" OR metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_repo_onboarded" | timechart span=1d sum(value) by channel limit=10
| where metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_interactive_repo_onboarded" OR metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_repo_onboarded" | stats sum(value) as onboarded by channel

| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" | dedup usage_dedupe | stats sum(input_tokens) as total count(input_tokens) as samples | eval total=if(samples>0,total,"not reported") | fields total

| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" | dedup usage_dedupe | stats sum(output_tokens) as total count(output_tokens) as samples | eval total=if(samples>0,total,"not reported") | fields total

| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" | dedup usage_dedupe | stats sum(cache_read_tokens) as total count(cache_read_tokens) as samples | eval total=if(samples>0,total,"not reported") | fields total

| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" | dedup usage_dedupe | stats sum(cache_write_tokens) as total count(cache_write_tokens) as samples | eval total=if(samples>0,total,"not reported") | fields total

| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" | dedup usage_dedupe | stats sum(reasoning_output_tokens) as total count(reasoning_output_tokens) as samples | eval total=if(samples>0,total,"not reported") | fields total

| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" | dedup usage_dedupe | stats sum(total_tokens) as total count(total_tokens) as samples | eval total=if(samples>0,total,"not reported") | fields total

| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" cost_basis="reported" | dedup usage_dedupe | stats sum(cost_usd) as total count(cost_usd) as samples | eval total=if(samples>0,round(total,2),"not reported") | fields total

| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" | dedup usage_dedupe | stats count as runs sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens sum(cache_read_tokens) as cache_read_tokens sum(cache_write_tokens) as cache_write_tokens sum(reasoning_output_tokens) as reasoning_output_tokens sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens by runtime | sort - total_tokens | table runtime, runs, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens, total_tokens

table.title: Cost by runtime and final total (USD)

search.query: | search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" | dedup usage_dedupe | stats count as runs values(cost_basis) as cost_basis count(eval(cost_basis="reported")) as costed_runs sum(eval(if(cost_basis="reported",cost_usd,null()))) as cost_usd by runtime | sort - cost_usd | appendpipe [| stats sum(runs) as runs sum(costed_runs) as costed_runs sum(cost_usd) as cost_usd | eval runtime="ALL RUNTIMES"] | eval cost_usd=if(costed_runs>0,printf("%.2f",cost_usd),"not reported") | table runtime, runs, costed_runs, cost_basis, cost_usd

| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage" stage!="diagnostics" stage!="dashboard-smoke-test" | eval timestamp=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z") | dedup usage_dedupe | eval cost_usd=if(cost_basis="reported",printf("%.2f",cost_usd),"unknown") | sort - _time | table timestamp, job_id, invocation_id, runtime, model, stage, skill_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens, total_tokens, usage_complete, cost_basis, cost_usd, status, repo_annotation_version, template_library_version, template_profile, target_repo_url
| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_onboarding_terminal" | timechart span=1d sum(value) by status limit=10
| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_used" | stats sum(value) as invocations by skill_id | sort - invocations | head 12
| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_completed" | stats sum(value) as completions by status | sort status

| search channel="interactive" | stats sum(value) as events latest(_time) as last_seen by metric_name | append [| makeresults | eval metric_name=split("cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_installed,cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_existing_install_detected,cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_onboarding_started,cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_onboarding_terminal,cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_interactive_repo_onboarded,cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_invocation_usage,cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_used,cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_completed,cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_content_iteration,cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_failure",",") | mvexpand metric_name | eval events=0] | stats sum(events) as events max(last_seen) as last_seen by metric_name | eval delivery=if(events>0,"received","not received") | eval last_seen=if(isnull(last_seen),"never in selected window",strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")) | sort metric_name | table metric_name, events, delivery, last_seen
| eval timestamp=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z") | sort - _time | head 100 | table timestamp, metric_name, channel, status, skill_id, runtime, target_repo_url, template_profile
| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_content_iteration" | stats sum(value) as iterations by reason | sort - iterations
| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_skill_failure" | stats sum(value) as failures by failure_kind | sort - failures
| search metric_name="cisco-aifirst_repo_annotation_job_terminal" | stats sum(value) as jobs by strategy | sort - jobs
